entries.title: Greeting
entries.question: Hi!
entries.answer: Hey — I'm Aditya's portfolio assistant. I can tell you about his background, projects, skills, experience, or how to contact him. Ask anything, or tap one of the category pills below the search bar.

entries.title: Fun facts
entries.question: Tell me something fun about Aditya.
entries.answer: Fun facts: Aditya started with a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, moved into IT support, and is now finishing a BCA while working in operations data and AI. He speaks five languages at different levels — English, Hindi, Bengali, basic Tamil, and basic Telugu — and describes himself as a practical jack-of-all-trades who learns fast. He also built the star-trail cursor and PowerShell theme on this page.

entries.title: Superpower
entries.question: What is Aditya's superpower?
entries.answer: His superpower is translation: taking a messy operational problem, a pile of ticket data, or a vague business question and turning it into a clean metric, a useful dashboard, or an AI-assisted workflow that a team can actually adopt. He pairs analytical thinking with documentation and cross-functional communication.

entries.title: Move into AI
entries.question: Why is Aditya moving into AI engineering?
entries.answer: Aditya's path went from hands-on IT support to operational analytics, and AI is the next layer: using retrieval, prompt engineering, and automation to make analysis faster and more accessible. He is especially interested in grounded AI systems — assistants that cite sources, admit when an answer is missing, and hand off cleanly to a human.

entries.title: How this assistant works
entries.question: How does this assistant work?
entries.answer: This assistant is a client-side retrieval engine. It builds a TF-IDF index from the JSON files in data/knowledge-base, expands your question with a small synonym map, and compares it with every knowledge entry. If the best match clears a confidence threshold, it returns the curated answer. If not, it shows a fixed fallback and offers a direct route to the Contact section — no generated guesses.

entries.title: Working together
entries.question: Can I work with Aditya?
entries.answer: Yes. Aditya is open to full-time roles, collaborative projects, and conversations around AI-assisted reporting, operations analytics, data quality, and dashboard automation. Email adi.mech.32@gmail.com or use the form in the Contact section with a short note about what you have in mind.

entries.title: Location and time zone
entries.question: Where is Aditya based?
entries.answer: Aditya is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, which is India Standard Time (UTC+5:30). He is open to remote roles and relocation, and has experience supporting teams across multiple time zones.

entries.title: Compensation
entries.question: What are Aditya's salary expectations?
entries.answer: Compensation details are not published here. Please reach out directly at adi.mech.32@gmail.com or through the Contact section, and Aditya will be happy to discuss the role and expectations.

entries.title: Questions outside the knowledge base
entries.question: What if my question is not covered?
entries.answer: This assistant answers strictly from Aditya's curated knowledge base. If a question is not covered, it will say so and offer the Contact options. For anything personal or time-sensitive, email is the most reliable route.
